sql: SELECT 'cost_rows_dec' metric,COUNT(*) n FROM costs k JOIN times t USING(time_id) WHERE calendar_year=2021 AND calendar_month_number=12 UNION ALL SELECT 'cost_keys_dec',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT prod_id,k.time_id,channel_id,promo_id FROM costs k JOIN times t USING(time_id) WHERE calendar_year=2021 AND calendar_month_number=12) UNION ALL SELECT 'all_italian_customers',COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN countries n USING(country_id) WHERE n.country_name='Italy'

WITH december AS (SELECT s.* FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries n ON n.country_id=c.country_id WHERE n.country_name='Italy' AND t.calendar_year=2021 AND t.calendar_month_number=12),lines AS (SELECT d.*,k.unit_cost,k.unit_price,d.amount_sold-d.quantity_sold*k.unit_cost line_profit,d.quantity_sold*(k.unit_price-k.unit_cost) list_profit FROM december d LEFT JOIN costs k ON k.prod_id=d.prod_id AND k.time_id=d.time_id AND k.channel_id=d.channel_id AND k.promo_id=d.promo_id),customer_profit AS (SELECT cust_id,SUM(line_profit) profit,SUM(list_profit) profit_by_list_price,COUNT(*) sale_rows FROM lines GROUP BY cust_id) SELECT COUNT(*) sale_rows,COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) active_customers,SUM(unit_cost IS NULL) missing_cost,MIN(amount_sold-quantity_sold*unit_price) min_revenue_delta,MAX(amount_sold-quantity_sold*unit_price) max_revenue_delta,SUM(line_profit) actual_profit,SUM(list_profit) list_profit FROM lines

WITH december AS (SELECT s.* FROM sales s JOIN times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN customers c ON c.cust_id=s.cust_id JOIN countries n ON n.country_id=c.country_id WHERE n.country_name='Italy' AND t.calendar_year=2021 AND t.calendar_month_number=12),lines AS (SELECT d.*,k.unit_cost,k.unit_price,d.amount_sold-d.quantity_sold*k.unit_cost line_profit,d.quantity_sold*(k.unit_price-k.unit_cost) list_profit FROM december d LEFT JOIN costs k ON k.prod_id=d.prod_id AND k.time_id=d.time_id AND k.channel_id=d.channel_id AND k.promo_id=d.promo_id),customer_profit AS (SELECT cust_id,SUM(line_profit) profit,SUM(list_profit) profit_by_list_price,COUNT(*) sale_rows FROM lines GROUP BY cust_id) ,allc AS (SELECT c.cust_id,COALESCE(cp.profit,0) profit FROM customers c JOIN countries n USING(country_id) LEFT JOIN customer_profit cp USING(cust_id) WHERE n.country_name='Italy'),v AS (SELECT 'all_customers_ntile' variant,cust_id,profit,NTILE(10) OVER(ORDER BY profit DESC,cust_id) tier FROM allc UNION ALL SELECT 'active_equal_width',cust_id,profit,MIN(10,1+CAST((profit-(SELECT MIN(profit) FROM customer_profit))*10.0/((SELECT MAX(profit) FROM customer_profit)-(SELECT MIN(profit) FROM customer_profit)) AS INTEGER)) tier FROM customer_profit) SELECT variant,tier,COUNT(*) customers,MAX(profit) max_profit,MIN(profit) min_profit FROM v GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
